scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build --workspace @hobbymaxx/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @hobbymaxx/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:server && npm run dev --workspace @hobbymaxx/server
scripts.test: npm run build:server && tsx --test apps/server/test/*.test.ts apps/web/test/*.test.ts
